question: Is AuroraPIC's lower positive work in the 11.5--15.8 eV band associated with weaker particle-sampled field strength, less favorable longitudinal velocity-field alignment, reduced longitudinal energy partition, or a lower origin-energy distribution?

basis.observed_before_declaration: Both locked AuroraPIC members have lower positive work and conditional promotion probability under the preceding prospective rule; the band-supply deficit is not supported. No production-state native or AuroraPIC mover-decomposition output exists.
basis.smoke_scope: One native cycle established passivity, exact algebraic closure, and bounded resources only. Its decomposition values are not used to set a production outcome.

derived_metrics.mean_origin_energy_eV: origin total kinetic-energy sum divided by band observations; within-band energy-distribution covariate
derived_metrics.origin_longitudinal_energy_fraction: origin longitudinal kinetic-energy sum divided by origin total kinetic-energy sum
derived_metrics.mean_positive_linear_work_eV: positive part of m*v_x*delta_v_x divided by band observations; favorable alignment metric
derived_metrics.mean_quadratic_work_eV: 0.5*m*delta_v_x^2 divided by band observations; particle-sampled field-strength metric proportional to E squared
derived_metrics.total_work_identity: signed mover work equals signed linear work plus nonnegative quadratic work

prospective_decision_rule.field_strength_deficit_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native mean-quadratic-work ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.favorable_alignment_deficit_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native mean-positive-linear-work ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.longitudinal_energy_partition_deficit_su: both AuroraPIC/native origin-longitudinal-energy-fraction ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.lower_origin_energy_distribution_support: both AuroraPIC/native mean-origin-energy ratios are at most 0.995
prospective_decision_rule.aurorapic_repeatability_gate: relative range no greater than 0.10 for all four declared metrics
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative three-seed range no greater than 0.15 for all four declared metrics
prospective_decision_rule.multiple_supported_mechanisms: allowed; metrics are exact decomposition terms or covariates and are not asserted to be statistically independent

claim_boundary: This prospective comparison decomposes one previously established near-threshold work discrepancy in one matched argon CCP. It does not identify the first self-consistent field divergence, compare experiment, establish a published benchmark pass, or prove general PIC correctness.
